profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Optro
profile.geoLocationName: White River Junction, Vermont, United States
profile.summary:
Entrepreneurial Software Development Professional.

Focused on creating engaging User Interfaces that make complex problems seem simple.

12 years focused on coding / 8 years Ember.js

Highly versatile and adaptable professional who is passionate about solving interesting problems and building value. 

Adept in coding, management, data analysis and visualization, web metrics and reporting, finance, legal matters, software development, operations, business development, and engineering. 

Learn quickly, highly motivated, and talented at communicating and negotiating between disparate parties.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Researching and Architecting large new features.
Architect and Lead Scenario Planning

Eradicating ambiguity, abstracting toward modularization for quick pivot and expansion.
Collaborating across teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Focused on Front End Development with Ember.js
- Building and overhauling large and complex features
- Updating older features and increasing test coverage
- Data visualization UI/UX
- Contributing to the Node.js back end to support front end work
- Working closely with product and design to develop and test new features
- Completed an application wide Ember-Data upgrade
- Conducting engineering candidate technical interviews

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
SeeClickFix / Civic Service
Front End UI/UX Development
- Modernized legacy Ember.js applications by implementing Ember Data and converting to Octane
- Implemented new UI features
- Built a new application in Ember.js with Typescript and GraphQL caching via Apollo
- Contributed to the Rails back end as needed to support front end development

positions.title: Senior Front End Developer & Lead Product Development Manager
positions.description:
Senior Front End Software Developer, Lead Product Development Manager, UI/UX Designer, and Analytics Engineer.

HereCast was a localized news and events content generation and distribution platform with an ad revenue sharing business model.

Primary responsibility as Senior Front End Developer (80% of the time):
 - Hands-on leadership over all UI development initiatives
 - Worked with product owners to identify and define user problems
 - Wireframed, designed, and coded prototype solutions in JavaScript and Ember.js 
 - Conducted real user testing and reiterated based on results
 - Coded acceptance, integration, and unit tests for new features
 - Deployed to production using continuous integration process
 - Monitored feature use via analytics, report results, and made changes based on data

Secondary responsibility as Lead Product Development Manager(20% of the time):
 - Led larger team of product managers
 - Grew monthly active users to 75% of the local market
 - Built, maintained, and grew web traffic by 100%
 - Rebranded business and built strategy for national visibility
 - Overhauled data structure to maximize user engagement and growth


Spec'd, contributed, and coordinated software development and UI/UX design through third party services.

Restructured and developed majority of Ember.js front end software application.

Built Android wrapper app.

Built out full business model and marketing analysis as basis for investor pitches.

Went through three GV Design Sprint weeks.

Worked in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, Kanban, and pretty much every other startup lingo-y type of scenario.

Was a Senior Software Developer mainly in Javascript using Ember.js, Node, Express, Next.js, Mongo, Rails for API, React.

Frequently used other tools like Git, CircleCI, Heroku, AWS, Slack, Trello, Clubhouse, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Maps API.

Basically, whatever needed to be done I could figure it out. That's the problem solver in me...

positions.title: Executive Consultant / Software Engineer
positions.description:
Providing a wide range of services including:
 - Developing web applications, sites and engineering tools
 - Marketing analysis, research, presentations
 - Business operations analysis
 - Fund raising
 - Intellectual property licensing

Some sample client projects:

Built financial and management models for self-storage facilities
(for a real estate collective)
 - Designed business model to produce 40% operating margin with 4 year exit plan
 - Completed full competitive market analysis and built projected financials

Built company identity website, menu admin tool, and social marketing campaign 
(for a local restaurant)
 - Developed marketing strategy resulting in net increase in revenue
 - Researched and analyzed competitive market to maximize efficiency of marketing efforts
 - Designed and built web site including tool for updating and maintaining live menus

Developed tools to capture low-volume/high-margin customers and optimize quoting process
(for a seasoned manufacturer)
 - Consolidated product portfolio from 9k items to less than 1k by eliminating end use redundancies
 - Designed and built web application to cut product quote time from over 6 weeks to 1 day
 - Created an algorithm to facilitate customer-relevant search of products

Last 5 years focused on Ember.js

Well versed in JavaScript, PHP, SQL, CSS, learning Ruby, AWS, Heroku, Android.

Using frameworks like Ember, Node, Joomla, Wordpress, GoogleMaps and Facebook APIs, and many plugins and add-ons.

Also programs like Git, Slack, SolidWorks, Adobe Suite

And management tools like Agile, Scrum, LeanUX,  Trello, Clubhouse, Gantt.

positions.title: Chief Executive Officer
positions.description:
MyGrove was an innovative social networking site for 55+ Active Adult Communities 
 - Built web application and assets for investor outreach
 - Coordinated 3rd party and contributed to app design and development
 - Developed fund raising strategy
 - Secured strategic partnership for pilot program
 - Built novel revenue model and value proposition 
 - Facilitated acceptance into the Aging2.0 (aging2.com) startup accelerator program
 - Coordinated over $100k in cash and $80k in-kind investment

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Started a crowdfunding business focused on facilitating investment into clean energy companies. 

Selected Achievements:
 - Developed financial lending model combining Royalty Based Financing and Charitable Giving
 - Organized advertising partnerships with 3 environmental nonprofits representing 7M members
 - Pitched at Ultra Light Startups: Future Energy and the annual Vermont Investors Forum
 - Panel participant at the JOBS Act forum hosted by the New England Clean Energy Council
 - Applied for two patents related to investment indexing algorithms and business model
 - Build marketing website
 - Built and launched an Android app to calculate energy and cost savings from changing light bulbs

positions.title: Chief Operating Officer
positions.description:
Directed the effort to finance expansion through private equity investment while managing all company business.

Selected achievements:
 - Negotiated minimum $20M over 10 years licensing agreement with Home Depot
 - Built value proposition in excess of $300M in annual infrastructure-wide energy savings for Walmart and negotiated prototype evaluation agreement based on verified calculations
 - Formulated Private Placement Memorandum and coordinated $1.5M private investment
 - Generated and directed effort to win $100k GE Ecomagination Innovation Award in 2010

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
Primary driving force behind the conversion of the company from a low yield consulting and
development firm to a licensor of its intellectual property rights. 

Selected Achievements:
 - Coordinated $4.5M private investment
 - Negotiated guaranteed $15 to $60M field-limited exclusive license to Enodis, Plc.
 - Saved $1.6M and 5% royalties due under licensing contract by negotiating a litigation settlement
 - Developed and hit target expense on $500k budget and plan to build new headquarters

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Researched ice friction enhancement methods with specific applications to car tires, skis, and refrigeration. Designed and built testing apparatuses utilizing 3D design software with CNC and manual machining.

company.name: Thayer School of Engineering at Dartmouth

positions.title: Founder / Author
positions.description:
Wrote and published self-help book and website selling over 10,000 copies. Coordinated use of multiple vendors to deliver products internationally. 

This is literally how I paid my way through college...
